_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); midstream signals

pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2013 10-K): The Partnership’s primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose it to commodity price risk are its percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Distribution policy: 'even if the Partnership’s business experiences fluctuations in its cash from operations due to seasonal and cyclical factors' (the boilerplate of the cash distribution policy, not a statement that the business is cyclical: the CHTR reading). Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is dependent upon the ability of the Partnership to make cash distributions to us.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names midstream energy; the 10-Ks' 'offshore' is the Gulf of Mexico, and they name cloud only as a director's other board, Cloud Peak Energy Inc.), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +55.3%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.8-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +55.3%/yr (FY11-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +55.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY13, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2014-11-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.65x (47.5% downside to Bear $63 / +73.4% upside to Bull $208) | Adj composite 3.00 vs market 1.87: gap +1.13 [UNDERVALUED] | +98% above the EPP floor $60 (39x FY14E $1.55) | Conservative 2-yr case: +50.7% total (+25.4%/yr) | At 77.4x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $159 sits at or below the BASE case; Gathering and Processing +27.7% and Logistics and Marketing +75.0% operating margin in Q3 2014, forward revenues +56.1% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2014 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
